subject: Bounded isolated original-client S5 gate visual-acquisition attempt from accepted-1995 checkpoint
setup: Recovered compatibility client 1.16.5.0; disposable deployed-derived Game/world and accepted-1995 character copies under /var/tmp; normal hostile stats/AI. No player position, combat-stat, mission or timer edit. Live Game/DIT untouched. Starts after mission 1995 acceptance, not with same-session Youngblood dialogue.

observations.finding: Mission 1995 objective 2 active at Youngblood-area copied checkpoint (93.2,115.0,137.5), level 2 and 8695 XP / 360 credits.

After ordinary five-second west-gate movement, moving Thrax Infantry Initiate was visible left of the original client centre reticle. The controller made bounded mouse-relative turns of -80 and -200 pixels and inspected rendered captures before firing. The target remained off-centre in the sampled frames; no rifle fire was issued.

The close-range gate hostile reached the character during the next attempted -500-pixel turn. Game log records death at (59.5,110.3,140.4), killed by creature 2758 class 29769 at (59.2,110.2,139.3), before any player rifle damage. Hospital respawn preserved objective 2 active and 8695 XP / 360 credits.

observations.finding: Focus guard identified the death UI; the isolated runner stopped with exit 0. Copied char DB was restored byte-for-byte to baseline SHA-256 c5e103ae4b3ba945a0925784b62eb144ebebb124b4eb4a3348a56cb9eb60b705.

assessment: A stepwise screenshot-and-turn gate targeting method was too slow against this normally attacking nearby hostile. This run does not test the outpost enemy or the wounded-soldier interaction and does not establish final-live combat balance. Prior run 1 in bootcamp-s5-accepted-prefix-normal-combat-20260924.json remains the evidence for a normal gate kill and continuous travel near the soldier.
next_verification: If another accepted-1995 normal-combat run is attempted, acquire and fire on the moving gate hostile immediately after it becomes visible, then inspect hit feedback while firing; later preemptively engage placement 198683 before entering the wounded-soldier bunker.
